Stake $50 of the chain's staking asset through Valantis stHYPE Restaking on Hyperliquid L1 and hold the receipt token. Cost: $50 of capital and about $1 of gas. Time: 15 minutes to set up.
Do this weekly: restake the receipt token's rewards through Valantis stHYPE Restaking each week. Cost: about $1 of gas a week. Time: 10 minutes a week.

stake a second $25 tranche through Valantis stHYPE Restaking after the first has aged two weeks. Hold the first position for at least 90 days so the activity is counted in more than one snapshot. Cost: the $50 stays in the position. Time: 90 days.

Before you withdraw, open the protocol's own points or rewards page and claim only from the link it publishes; never pay anyone to claim for you. Cost: no fee to check, and never pay to claim. Time: 10 minutes.
Write the wallet, the dates and every transaction hash in a farm log, then unwind in reverse order: close the second position first, then the first. Cost: nothing but the log. Time: 5 minutes.
